_comment: Engine latency budgets (LLD M1-16). These are the ENGINE's share, not whole-request budgets.
00 §4 NFR-PERF-01 allows p50 <= 20 ms and p99 <= 100 ms for a 100-rule decision INCLUDING the
durable write; NFR-PERF-02 allows p99 <= 250 ms for the large case. The engine must be a small
fraction of those, so a regression is caught here rather than when it eats the write's budget.
Measured on 2026-10-09: decision/100 p99 198 us, groupDecision p99 2777 us.
The ceilings are set with headroom over the measurement, not at it — a budget a passing build
sits exactly on fails on the next noisy runner and gets raised until it means nothing.

budgets.note: LLD M1-16: engine p99 <= 0.5 ms for 100 rules
LLD M1-16: engine p99 <= 50 ms for a 40-member group
